title: Chapter 346 Going To Lin'S House
content:
Chapter 346 Going To Lin'S House

However, Lu Daosheng still shook his head, "Let's do this, I'll cure your leg as a condition for you to return the Jiang family's property, okay?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Lin Ye's lame leg of the head of the Lin family and spoke calmly.

He actually didn't need to do this, but he didn't want to rob him like this.

He was just a lame leg, and he could cure it in an instant.

When Linye heard Lu Daosheng's words, he was buzzing at the moment.

"Lu, Mr. Lu, are you not kidding?"

"You think I'm joking?"

"No, no, but, my leg has been lame for decades,

Lin Ye felt like he was dreaming. His leg could not be cured for a long time, and he knew it.

Otherwise, with the strength of his Lin family, he would still not be able to cure a leg?

He never thought that there was hope for his leg.

Lin Xu, who was standing beside him, opened his mouth wide and stared at Lu Daosheng in front of him.

The guy in front of him dared to say such arrogant words as he could cure his grandfather's lame leg.

No, even this guy values this grandfather so much. What if he really has this ability.

Hiss, Damn, I actually got into such awesome existence.

He felt extremely grateful to think that he was still alive.

At this time, Lin Ye, the head of the Lin family, was already trembling with excitement.

"Mr. Lu, if you can really cure this leg from me, from now on, you will be my great benefactor of my Lin family and the most honorable guest of my Lin family."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand and signaled Linye to lie on the sofa.

Seeing this, Linye naturally did not dare to hesitate and almost rushed to the sofa and lay down.

"Mr. Lu, do we need to avoid it?"

At this time, Mr. Ma, who had been silent, clasped his fists and asked for instructions.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said lightly: "You can do whatever you want."

Mr. Ma hesitated for a moment and stayed there. The main reason was that he was really curious about how Lu Daosheng would cure the head of the family's lame leg.

And just as Lu Daosheng reached out to prepare for action.

Dou, Dou, Dou,

"grass!"

Lin Ye cursed angrily and took out his cell phone to take a look.

beep,,

Forestry died directly, turned his head and looked at Lu Daosheng and smiled, "Mr. Lu, you can continue."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand again.

ding, ding, ding,

Bang!

Forestry was furious and smashed his phone directly.

This old thing always hurts me.

He cursed in his heart and quickly looked at Lu Daosheng.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was not angry, he breathed a sigh of relief.

"Sir, no one will disturb you this time."

As he said that, Lin Ye turned his head and looked at Mr. Ma beside him, "Old Ma, take people outside to guard. No one is allowed to enter without my order."

"Yes, the head of the family."

Although he really wanted to stay, he naturally did not dare to refuse the orders from the head of the family.

After looking at Lin Xu who was still sitting on the ground, Ma hesitated for a moment, then turned around and left here.

On the other side.

Mr. Jiang, who was sitting at home waiting for news, suddenly received a call.

"Hey, Lao Li, is it done?"

"It's bad, Lao Jiang, I don't know what happened to the Lin family. If that old guy doesn't answer my phone, I guess your fucking grandson will be over."

"What!?"

Mr. Jiang stood up with a loud voice, his face feeling a little panicked.

Jiang Xiaoxiao, who was almost asleep waiting beside him, was startled and looked at his grandfather, "Grandpa, what happened?"

She had an ominous premonition in her heart at this moment.

"Old Jiang, don't be excited. Isn't it just a godson? It's not a kiss, you,

"Shut up, I will save him no matter what I say!"

"You, oops, forget it, then I'll accompany you to the Lin family."

The phone was hung up, and Mr. Jiang quickly got up and put on his shoes and was about to go out.

"Grandpa, I'm going too!"

Seeing that his grandfather was about to leave, Jiang Xiaoxiao was anxious.

"Xiaoxiao, stay for your family."

"I don't want it!"

"I'm just going to pick up your brother back, it's nothing."

Seeing Jiang Xiaoxiao like this, Old Master Jiang just deceived him.

"You are lying!"

Dou Da's tears gushed out from Jiang Xiaoxiao's eyes, and of course she could hear what happened on the phone just now.

Something must have happened to Brother Sheng.

Maybe it's a lot of luck now.

The situation was urgent at this moment, and Old Master Jiang sighed and had to take Jiang Xiaoxiao with him.

As soon as I got off the floor, a black Porsche had already parked downstairs.

The car window slowly shook down.

An old face is in sight.

"Lao Jiang, your complexion looks better than mine now."

"Stop talking nonsense, take me to the Lin family as soon as possible."

Mr. Jiang said politely.

The old man didn't say much about this, but just waited for the two of them to get in the car and ordered the driver to drive.

......

Lin family.

Looking at Lu Daosheng who was about to take action, Lin Xu sat aside, feeling a little at a loss.

He really wanted to ask, don’t you even need to take anesthetics?

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already placed his hand on the forestry lame leg.

Immediately afterwards, a gentle force continued to flow from Lu Daosheng's body into the lame legs of Forestry along his arms.

In an instant, forestry seemed to have reached the Pure Land, and couldn't help but make an extremely comfortable sound.

"Satisfactory~"

For the treatment of forestry lameness, this is enough for Lu Daosheng to have hands.

It's just that it's just that the broken tissue and nerves are reborn, and there's no difficulty at all.

Just a moment later, Lu Daosheng withdrew his hand.

"alright."

Lu Daosheng leaned against the back of the sofa, looking lazy.

"Okay? That's it, that's it?"

On the side, Lin Xu was completely stunned.

Is this a minute?

Lin Ye was also stunned. Then, he couldn't help but stand up and moved his legs.

"Okay, OK, really!"

"Hahahahahahahaha, so good, my legs are ready!"

The laughter of joy from the depths of my heart kept ringing from the inside of the house.

Lin Xu was completely convinced by Lu Daosheng at this moment.

A master is really a master.

"Master, wuwuwu, you really don't show your appearance. I will never accept anyone in my life, but I can't refuse you!"

Lin Xu actually knelt down directly at Lu Daosheng.

The young master of the Lin family, the future heir of the Lin family, now kneels down to an outsider.

However, this not only did not make Lin Ye, the head of the Lin family, but also nodded with relief.

This kid finally has some vision.

When Lu Daosheng heard Lin Xu's words, he was slightly stunned.

Why does this sound so familiar?

"You are afraid you have something to ask me?"

Lu Daosheng came to his senses and looked at Lin Xu, saying meaningfully.

Upon hearing this, Lin Xu immediately showed an awkward smile.

"Master, what I said just now is definitely from the bottom of my heart, but I do have a little bit of something I want to ask for help, I don't know,"

Small things.

Lu Daosheng looked at Lin Xu's body seriously, then smiled.

And just then, there was a noise outside the house.

"My surname is Lin, you can release my grandson immediately, otherwise even if I fight for this old bone, I will definitely not be able to spare you!"
